value: **Direct Callouts & Context**: "Our preliminary analyses identified: (1) launchpads for ethical sensemaking, instances where students leveraged their lived experiences, community discussion, and ethical scaffolding to begin reasoning about moral dilemmas, and (2) expressions of ethical sensemaking, signals within students’ reasoning processes that indicated critical sensemaking was taking place." | "Our purpose was to scaffold ethically sensemaking in different ways about issues that were related to them and their communities." | "Students made sense of the moral and ethical complexities around technology when they either (1) made connections to their lives outside the classroom, (2) collaborated with their peers within the community of inquiry, and (3) engaged with the scaffolding of the moral prisms meaningfully."
